sample_end_note: Opening date (UTC calendar date) must fall on or before sample_end_date. The default is the UTC date of the run. April 28, 2026 is the Hou–Li–Zheng Kalshi archive cutoff and is left unset unless --end-date passes it.
volume_definition: cumulative_volume is Gamma volumeNum when that field is present, otherwise volume. The paper threshold of 10,000 counts Kalshi contracts. Polymarket volumeNum/volume is lifetime size and is typically USD notional, not a contract count. volume_unit in the CSV is usd_notional.
life_definition: scheduled_life_days = (expiry - opening timestamp) in days of 86400 seconds. Opening prefers startDate, startDateIso, event.startDate, then createdAt, event.createdAt, event.creationDate. Expiry prefers endDate, endDateIso, event.endDate, event.endDateIso. closedTime and gameStartTime are not used.
unit_of_analysis: One binary market (exactly two outcomes) is one contract, including siblings in the same event. Open and closed markets are both eligible.
not_inclusion_rules: days to expiry on a trade date
cash day when fewer than 10 markets pass

paging.note: Offset paging fails above 2000. order=volume_num is rejected; the JSON field is volumeNum. Bands overlap on the boundary and market ids are deduped. volume1wk is not a stop rule. A live check on 2026-11-07 found the archived query parameter ignored, so closed markets are whatever closed=true returns.
